b2-18-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What Zoltán Hopes For
b2-18-01.scenario: On the veranda, Csörgheő Csuli asks you, Szakhmáry Zoltán's friend, what Zoltán wants with his new model farm.
b2-18-01.prompt: Tell Csuli what Zoltán strives for and what he trusts will happen.
cues: Say what he trusts will happen
b2-18-01.target: Zoltán arra törekszik, hogy modern gazdaságot építsen, és abban bízik, hogy a tervei sikerülnek.
b2-18-01.english: Zoltán strives to build a modern farm, and he trusts that his plans will succeed.
b2-18-01.canDo: I can construct cataphoric demonstrative frames with arra, abban, ahhoz, and azzal

b2-18-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What Csuli Thinks
b2-18-02.scenario: In the village, a neighbour asks you what Csörgheő Csuli thinks of Szakhmáry Zoltán's plans.
b2-18-02.prompt: Tell your neighbour Csuli's position and the conclusion he has reached.
cues: Say what conclusion he has reached about the plans
b2-18-02.target: Csuli azon az állásponton van, hogy a gépek nem kellenek, és arra a következtetésre jutott, hogy a tervek túl drágák.
b2-18-02.english: Csuli takes the position that the machines are not needed, and he has come to the conclusion that the plans are too expensive.
b2-18-02.canDo: I can deploy nominal-cataphoric frames to express institutional and scholarly stances

b2-18-03.title: Communicative Challenge: One Strong Sentence
b2-18-03.scenario: Szakhmáry Zoltán asks you, his friend, to say in one strong sentence what he and Csuli need most.
b2-18-03.prompt: Say what the two friends need, with strong emphasis.
cues: Start with a strong word of emphasis
Say what they need to believe in
b2-18-03.target: Pontosan arra van szükségünk, hogy higgyünk a jövőben.
b2-18-03.english: Precisely what we need is to believe in the future.
b2-18-03.canDo: I can front-shift cataphoric demonstratives for intense rhetorical emphasis

b2-18-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Slogan for the Farm
b2-18-04.scenario: Szakhmáry Zoltán wants a motto for his model farm and asks you to say what it should urge people to do.
b2-18-04.prompt: Tell Zoltán what his slogan should call on people to do.
cues: Say what the slogan calls on people to do
b2-18-04.target: A jelmondat arra szólítja fel az embereket, hogy dolgozzanak együtt a jövőért.
b2-18-04.english: The slogan calls on people to work together for the future.
b2-18-04.canDo: I can deconstruct how slogans use cataphoric frames to steer public attention

b2-18-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Few Words at the Celebration
b2-18-05.scenario: At a celebration on the estate, Szakhmáry Zoltán asks you to say two ceremonial sentences to the guests.
b2-18-05.prompt: Say an opening line about what you remember today and a closing pledge.
cues: Say what you hold on to
b2-18-05.target: Arra emlékezünk ma, hogy a hőseink a hazáért harcoltak, és ahhoz ragaszkodunk, hogy mindenki szabad maradjon.
b2-18-05.english: We remember today that our heroes fought for the homeland, and we insist that everyone remain free.
b2-18-05.canDo: I can compose a formal keynote speech using an array of cataphoric clause structures

b2-18-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Debts and Plans
b2-18-consolidation.scenario: Csörgheő Csuli asks you whether Szakhmáry Zoltán has thought about the growing interest on his debts.
b2-18-consolidation.prompt: Tell Csuli what Zoltán did not reckon with and what he still trusts.
cues: Say what Zoltán did not reckon with
b2-18-consolidation.target: Zoltán nem számolt azzal, hogy a kamatok egyre nagyobbak, de abban bízik, hogy a terve sikerül.
b2-18-consolidation.english: Zoltán did not reckon with the interest growing, but he trusts that his plan will succeed.
b2-18-consolidation.canDo: I can deploy case-marked cataphoric anchors (arra, abban, ahhoz, azzal + hogy) in complex sentences
